clue.text: Backing innocent against officer's deception

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the whole string built here is read from the end

parts.note: innocent means pure
V is short for versus, against
OC is short for officer commanding

explanation.surface: A wronged innocent person stands against an officer accused of deceit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing' looks like support for the innocent, but it says the whole string is read in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A cover-up is a concealment of the truth, a form of deception practised by those in authority.

clue.text: Husband entering plants joint with son for contests

indicators.note: with means the son simply joins on at the end of the string
entering means the husband goes inside the plants

parts.note: campions are flowering plants
the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: A husband walks among flowers with a sore joint, accompanied by his son.
explanation.definitionFit: Championships are competitions to decide a title holder, so they are contests.

clue.text: Heroic victor over boxer, six-footer

indicators.note: over means placed above the next piece in this down entry

parts.note: V is Victor in the radio alphabet
Muhammad Ali, the famous boxer
an ant is an insect with six feet

explanation.surface: A heroic winner beats a boxer who stands six feet tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person; it is a six-legged insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Valiant means brave and courageous, the qualities of a hero.

clue.text: Expensive climbing frames tons valued

indicators.note: frames means surrounds the other letter like a picture frame
climbing in a down clue means the word reads upwards, from the bottom

parts.note: dear means expensive

explanation.surface: Pricey climbing frames weighing tons are highly prized.
explanation.definitionFit: Rated means assessed or esteemed, given a value or worth.

clue.text: Thief interrupted by small dog

indicators.note: interrupted by means the thief word is split by a letter inserted into it

parts.note: a pincher is one who pinches, steals

explanation.surface: A burglar is disturbed by a little dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinscher is a breed of dog, such as the Dobermann or miniature pinscher.

clue.text: Jointly endorse function in auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where things are heard, so this signals a sound-alike

parts.note: the cosine is a trigonometric function

explanation.surface: Two parties sign off on an event to be held in a concert hall.
explanation.definitionFit: To cosign is to add a second signature, endorsing a document together with another person.

clue.text: He dictated what might precede salad

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Julius ..., dictator of Rome
second meaning: the name of a well-known salad

explanation.surface: A man dictated something to come before a salad course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dictated' suggests dictating letters; Caesar was a Roman dictator.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius Caesar ruled Rome as dictator, and a Caesar salad bears his name in its title.

clue.text: Fellow is drawn into fake religion

indicators.note: drawn into means the fellow and is are pulled inside the fake

parts.note: a sham is a fake
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A man is lured into a bogus faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Shamanism is a belief system centred on shamans contacting spirits, so it is a kind of religion.

clue.text: Broke all contact with good journalist protecting entertainer

indicators.note: protecting means the outer letters shelter the entertainer inside them

parts.note: ED is short for editor, a journalist
a host entertains guests

explanation.surface: Someone cut off a good journalist who was shielding a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: G and ED together surround HOST.
explanation.definitionFit: To ghost someone is modern slang for ending a relationship by suddenly ceasing all communication.

clue.text: Suddenly giant turned on expert guards

indicators.note: guards means the expert's letters stand around the others

parts.note: an ace is an expert

indicators.note: turned means the word for giant is read backwards

parts.note: giant means tall

explanation.surface: A giant abruptly rounds on the experts keeping him in check.
explanation.walkthrough: TALL 'turned' gives LLAT; add ON, and ACE 'guards' LLATON.
explanation.definitionFit: All at once is an idiom meaning without warning, abruptly, the same as suddenly.

clue.text: Keen to keep old duck

indicators.note: to keep means the keen word holds the other letter inside it

parts.note: keen means avid

explanation.surface: An enthusiast is eager to own a vintage duck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' looks like the bird; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To duck something is to dodge or evade it, so the verb sense matches avoid as a synonym.

clue.text: Drink in jar delegate's drunk

indicators.note: drunk means the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A delegate is drunk on a drink from a jar.
explanation.definitionFit: Darjeeling tea is a fine black tea from India, a beverage brewed and sipped.

clue.text: Set down on soft cloth

indicators.note: on means the set-down word comes after the other piece

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for soft
set down means laid

explanation.surface: Something is placed down on a soft fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaid is a woven tartan fabric, so it is a kind of cloth.

clue.text: Letter and formal deed about account

indicators.note: about means the formal deed goes around the account

parts.note: a charter is a formal written grant or deed

explanation.surface: A letter accompanies a formal deed concerning a bank account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' suggests correspondence; it is a single written symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A character is a written symbol, and a letter of the alphabet is one such symbol.

clue.text: In disorder, cue riots and protests

indicators.note: in disorder means these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Amid chaos, a signal sets off riots and demonstrations.
explanation.definitionFit: Outcries are loud public objections, which are protests voiced strongly.

clue.text: Regularly decrypted your intel

indicators.note: decrypted means a code is worked out, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Your intelligence reports are decoded as a matter of course.
explanation.definitionFit: Routinely means as a matter of habit, happening on a regular basis.

clue.text: Intervening, one succeeds for all to see in confusion

indicators.note: succeeds means one thing takes over another's place, replacing it

parts.note: a muddle is a state of confusion
U is the British film certificate for universal viewing, suitable for everyone
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone steps in and triumphs openly amid the chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: U (Universal, the British film rating) in MUDDLE is replaced by I.
explanation.definitionFit: Middle as an adjective describes what lies between two others, the intervening position.

clue.text: Monk in Mont-Saint-Michel is in charge of dwelling-place

parts.note: Dom is a title given to some monks
est is the French for is, Mont-Saint-Michel being in France

explanation.surface: A monk at Mont-Saint-Michel runs the monastery's living quarters.
explanation.walkthrough: Mont-Saint-Michel is an island abbey in France, so 'is' there is French EST.
explanation.definitionFit: Domestic means relating to the home or household, a place where people live.

clue.text: Spring, not oddly, is a part available

indicators.note: not oddly means skipping the odd-placed letters and keeping the even ones

parts.note: out means available, as a book out in the shops

explanation.surface: A spring, unevenly, is a component one can buy.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'is a part' give SPR.
explanation.definitionFit: To sprout is to spring up, as a shoot appears and grows quickly.

clue.text: Criticise soldiers for case of vengeance

parts.note: RE are the Royal Engineers, soldiers
pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside, so only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone condemns troops for seeking revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to rebuke or scold, finding fault with someone.

clue.text: Shared this, literally entertaining a French learner

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the punctuation word holds the French article

parts.note: the mark printed just before these words, after 'Shared', is literally a comma
un is the French for a
L is the learner-driver plate

explanation.surface: A shared item is being taken literally while a French student is hosted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' points at the comma printed beside it, so it means COMMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Communal describes something held in common by a group, so it is shared among them.

clue.text: Concepts central characters in Pentagon dismissed in writings

indicators.note: dismissed means sent away, so these letters are removed

parts.note: notations are written records

indicators.note: central characters means the middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: Ideas from the Pentagon's leading figures are rejected in written documents.
explanation.walkthrough: TA, the middle of Pentagon, is 'dismissed' from NOTATIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Notions are ideas or beliefs held in the mind, so they are concepts.

clue.text: Mike cutting father's grass

indicators.note: cutting means the letter slices into the father word

parts.note: papa's: papa is father, with the possessive S
M is Mike in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: Mike is mowing his dad's lawn.
explanation.definitionFit: The pampas are vast South American grasslands, and pampas grass is a tall ornamental plant.

clue.text: Shunning all outsiders, simply pick matey associate

indicators.note: shunning all outsiders means each word loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Avoiding strangers, someone just chooses a friendly companion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'associate' looks like a noun; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To implicate someone is to connect or involve them in something, to associate them with it.

clue.text: Staff strike concerning

parts.note: to bat is to strike, as a ball
on means concerning, about

explanation.surface: Employees go on strike over a matter of concern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff strike' reads as workers walking out; staff is a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A baton is a short stick, and a staff is likewise a rod carried in the hand.

clue.text: Informed of spaces for loading surface material

indicators.note: informed of suggests being told, so what is heard, a sound-alike

parts.note: loading bays are spaces where vehicles load

explanation.surface: Someone is told about loading areas for carrying flooring material.
explanation.definitionFit: Baize is the green woollen fabric covering snooker and card tables, a playing-surface cloth.

clue.text: Heating apparatus part of newest oven

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A heating device is a component of the latest oven.
explanation.definitionFit: A stove is a closed appliance burning fuel or using electricity to warm a room or cook.

clue.text: Garment unfortunately apt to clash primarily with tie

indicators.note: unfortunately means things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled
primarily means taking just the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An item of clothing sadly tends to clash with a necktie.
explanation.definitionFit: A petticoat is an underskirt, a piece of clothing worn beneath a dress.

clue.text: Gems from abbey royals so regularly used

indicators.note: regularly used means only every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: Jewels come from an abbey that royals often visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Beryls are precious minerals; emerald and aquamarine are varieties, so they are gemstones.

clue.text: Clough's wingers advanced on other team

indicators.note: on means the advanced letter is placed after the other word
wingers are the outside players, so take the outside letters of the manager's name

parts.note: Brian Clough was a famous English football manager; his name's outer letters
else means other
A is short for advanced, as in A level

explanation.surface: Brian Clough's wide players push forward against a rival football side.
explanation.walkthrough: Brian Clough managed Nottingham Forest; CHELSEA is a London football club. A is placed after ELSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Chelsea is a Premier League football club, a particular example of a sports side.
